name: Voiceflow
positioning: Voiceflow is a collaborative agent-building platform for customer-experience teams and agencies that deploys chat and phone agents.

pricing.model: Monthly plan fee (Free, Pro, Business, Enterprise) plus add-ons (editor seats, extra phone numbers, concurrent calls) and credit-based usage for phone minutes, LLM, STT and TTS.
pricing.headline: Phone usage is listed at $0.05 per minute in the credits table, with LLM, speech-to-text and text-to-speech charged separately by vendor and model, on top of a monthly plan fee whose amount is not shown on the public pages read.
planNotes: Plans named in billing docs: Free, Pro (individual builders), Business (teams), Enterprise (custom).
Plan prices and credit bundle sizes are shown inside the app (Plans and Billing); the public pricing page offers 'Start building for clients' for agencies and 'Request pricing' for businesses.
One Voiceflow phone number per workspace is included; extra numbers and extra concurrent calls are add-ons.
Free plan has a one-time credit grant that does not renew and is described by Voiceflow as not suitable for production.
The $0.05/min figure comes from a single docs page (credits pricing table, 'Self-serve pricing' tab); the marketing pricing page does not list it.
pricing.freeTrial: Free plan with a one-time credit grant; the pricing page says free trial, no credit card required (agency track).
whatIsExtra: LLM usage per token by model (for example listed per 1K input and output tokens)
Speech-to-text per minute by vendor (for example Deepgram, AssemblyAI, Google)
Text-to-speech per 1K characters by vendor (for example ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Amazon)
Additional editor seats, phone numbers and concurrent calls

strengths.claim: Visual, collaborative builder with environments (development, staging, production) and traffic splitting that also applies to phone numbers.
Lets you connect numbers from Twilio, Vonage or Telnyx, or have Voiceflow provision a US or Canadian number, for inbound and outbound calls and SMS.
Model choice across the large LLM vendors, and the pricing page says you can bring your own model.
Lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR and HIPAA on its security page and says customer data is not used to train models.
Agencies get multi-client workspaces, white-labelling and client handoff tools according to the pricing page.

limitations.claim: Plan prices, credit bundles and add-on prices are viewed inside the product, so total cost is harder to estimate from public pages alone.
Each plan has a concurrent calls limit for phone; more capacity is an add-on.
The Free plan's credit grant is one-time and described as not suitable for production use.

integrations: Twilio, Vonage and Telnyx phone numbers

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested: the security page lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR and HIPAA with links to a Trust Center. Whether a BAA is offered and on which plan was not stated on the pages read; billing docs mention advanced security and compliance features on Enterprise.

telephony.providedNumbers: Voiceflow can provision US or Canadian numbers (one included per workspace, more as add-on); numbers can also be connected from Twilio, Vonage or Telnyx using account credentials.

stepsToLeave: Call the Export environment API (GET /v1/stable/environment/{environmentAlias}/export with projectID) to serialise the agent, playbooks, tools and knowledge base into one JSON document.
The export is described as a document you can archive or move to another Voiceflow project; mapping it to another platform is not documented by Voiceflow.

bestFor: Product and CX teams and agencies that want a visual, collaborative builder for chat and phone agents and are fine with usage credits on top of a plan fee.

sources.title: Voiceflow docs: Connecting a phone number

unknowns: Monthly plan prices (Pro, Business) and credit bundle sizes; shown inside the app.
Whether a BAA is available and on which plan.
What share of phone-call cost is Voiceflow's $0.05/min versus passed-through telephony for Voiceflow-provisioned numbers.
Whether Voiceflow-provisioned numbers can be ported out.
